claim: demucs-onnx 0.3.4 publishes ONNX exports of htdemucs, htdemucs_ft (4 specialists) and htdemucs_6s, each in fp32 and fp16weights variants
demucs-onnx ships a browser-demo scaffolder and bundler configs (vite, webpack, esbuild, rollup, next)
source: browser.py demo imports ORT 1.18.0 ort.min.mjs, which does not exist in that release; no evidence of a working browser path (SP-1)

claim: GitHub Pages cannot set COOP/COEP; coi-serviceworker (MIT, 0.1.7, last published 2023-07) injects them via a service worker + reload
source: npm registry; ORT dist references crossOriginIsolated/SharedArrayBuffer

claim: ORT Web 1.30.0 default entry supports 'webgpu' and 'wasm' EPs; WebGPU path works on 1.30 but not on 1.22 (exception) or 1.18 (uses removed requestAdapterInfo)
Model I/O: input 'mix' (1,2,343980) float32 @44.1 kHz; output 'stems' (1,4,2,343980); sources drums,bass,other,vocals; 1/4 overlap, triangular window, weight-normalised OLA
Measured on a 4-core Intel Gen9 laptop: WebGPU 1.26 s per chunk warm (4-min song ~1 min separation), 3-thread WASM 21.8 s per chunk (~15 min); htdemucs_ft costs 4x
All processing is client-side; audio never uploaded
Each fp16weights model (htdemucs and each ft specialist) is 165,612,636 bytes
Default ORT import loads ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.{mjs,wasm} (~28.3 MB wasm); plain threaded wasm is ~14.2 MB. Original 11.79 MB figure was wrong
demucs-onnx vanilla demo imports ORT 1.18.0 from jsDelivr; must be replaced with local assets
HF resolve/ URLs 302 to us.aws.cdn.hf.co; both hops send CORS headers; browser fetch works under COEP require-corp

htdemucs fp16weights loads in ORT Web 1.30 when graph optimisation is disabled (with CPU arena and memory-pattern off): wasm heap ~420 MB after create, ~890 MB after first run. With optimisation basic/all the 4 GB wasm heap is exhausted.
ORT 1.30 threaded WASM uses same-origin module workers; no CSP worker-src violations
htdemucs single-file fp16weights download is 165,612,636 bytes
